body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete

GO:0042077 protein phosphate-linked glycosylation via serine 
GO:0018240 protein S-linked glycosylation via cysteine  ->protein S-linked glycosylation
GO:0018241 protein O-linked glycosylation via hydroxylysine 
GO:0097370 protein O-GlcNAcylation via threonine 
GO:0018245 protein O-linked glycosylation via tyrosine 


see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29770

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YP6wvNfPvWjKvipuSqI4fU7a6ymPO_fHihSMATQkwJM/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
UniProt 1 @Antonialock  (AUTOMATIC REPLACEMENT)
FlyBase 1 (I assume this one is already removed) @rozaru 



Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)
